Part 26.3. Similar goods and closely related services

Section 44 requires the examiner to consider whether the goods or services of the application are the same as, or similar to, those of the cited trade mark.

3.1 Goods of the same description

When assessing whether goods are of the same description, the examiner considers the nature of the goods, their purpose, and the trade channels through which they are sold.

  • Clothing and knitted garments are generally goods of the same description.

3.2 Closely related services

Goods and services can be closely related, for example retail services in relation to clothing and clothing itself.
